svg.title: Minecraft Halloween tech stack
svg.desc: Five bold category signs and twenty fixed pixel-art technology items. LANGUAGES: Python, C++, HTML, CSS. FRAMEWORKS: PyTorch, FastAPI, Streamlit, scikit-learn, LangChain, LangGraph. DATABASES: Firebase, ChromaDB, Supabase. TOOLS: Git, GitHub, Docker, VS Code, Jupyter. AI ASSISTANTS: Codex, Antigravity. Only Halloween decorations move.
